thread:
emma_peopleops: Heads up — small policy update rolling out today re: annual leave reset window and travel reimbursements. TL;DR: we’re shifting the leave reset to the first Monday in January, allowing 10 days carryover (up from 5) for 2024–2025, and clarifying per-diem receipts. See details below.

 tanya_peopleops: Full notes here — apologies for the long thread. Qs welcome.

 emma_peopleops: Why the change? We got consistent feedback that Jan 1 reset caused accrual drop issues for people on year-end projects; moving to first Monday gives smoother transitions. Also finance asked to standardize per-diem caps to reduce manual corrections.

 raj_eng: Does this affect payout for unused days if someone leaves mid-year?

 tanya_peopleops: Good Q. For separations, we’ll continue to pay out unused balance pro-rated based on last approved policy. Only the reset timing/carryover limit changed.

 luis_finance: Adding from finance: per-diem caps are now $75/day domestic, $150/day international. Receipts required for any single expense > $25. Please use the new expense code TRV-PD in Concur.

 raj_eng: @luis_finance will this change retroactively apply to trips that started before the policy date but expenses submitted after?

 luis_finance: No retroactive changes. Effective for travel that departs on or after 2024-11-01. Expenses for earlier trips follow the old rules.

 jen_hrbp: Also note: we adjusted bereavement leave language to explicitly include chosen family — that’s effective immediately.

 tanya_peopleops: Implementation notes:
 • Leave reset: first Monday in January (calendar note set for 2025 -> Jan 6)
 • Carryover: up to 10 days for the 2024–2025 accrual year only (one-time exception)
 • Payout on separation: unchanged, pro-rated
 • Per-diem: caps and receipt thresholds as Luis posted
 • Expense code: TRV-PD (Concur). Travel-bot will auto-tag new submissions with missing codes.

 travel-bot: automated message: Please attach receipts when submitting Concur expenses. Missing receipts may delay reimbursements.

 emma_peopleops: Action items for managers: 1) remind teams to plan end-of-year time-off earlier, 2) approve carryover requests in Workday by Dec 18, 3) flag any off-cycle separations to People Ops for payout calculations.

 raj_eng: Thanks. How do we request the one-time carryover? Form or message?

 tanya_peopleops: Submit a carryover request in Workday with manager approval. We’ll auto-approve up to 10 days for this window.

 jen_hrbp: Also rolling out a short code-of-conduct refresher course — 15 min — to be completed by all employees by Dec 31. Will send the link Monday.

 emma_peopleops: Final note: this is a tweak to help folks — not reducing benefits. Happy to hop on quick calls if teams need clarification. :heart: 

 raj_eng: Appreciated. :thumbsup: 

 luis_finance: FYI: finance will batch-check Concur reports every Friday during the rollout period.

 tanya_peopleops: Thanks everyone — filing the policy diff and the FAQ doc in #docs-policies. Will follow up with a short FAQ digest.

 emma_peopleops: End of thread — ping us in DM for anything sensitive.
